title: Directory
licence: Copyright © 2023 City Government of Dagupan. All Rights Reserved. (site footer)

The CMS reports article:modified_time 2026-07-14T06:16:03Z, but every department page on the site was re-saved within 70 minutes that day and the newest stamp belongs to the most obviously superseded roster, so that timestamp records a bulk re-save rather than editorial currency and is deliberately NOT recorded as `published`. Agrees with the Officials-section roster except on the City Information Office head and four City Health Office numbers. Re-read 2026-11-10: article:modified_time is unchanged from the August reading, and every published department head and contact number was re-checked against it. Its second table, headed "Office | Mobile Number/s | Landline", is the 14-row emergency hotline list transcribed in src/data/directory/hotlines.json; that list is repeated on the Contact Us page, so the two count as one list for corroboration. One row is internally inconsistent: PAMANA (Dagupan City Water District) is given "515-3140", the City Social Welfare and Development Office's number, and this page's first table writes it "(075 515-3140" with an unclosed parenthesis.

title: Team Unliserbisyo Secures Majority Seats in the 2025 Local Elections
licence: Copyright © 2023 City Government of Dagupan. All Rights Reserved. (site footer)
notes: The city's article of 13 May 2025 reporting the results of the 12 May 2025 local elections, which is why the release date and the reference date differ. It reports that "incumbent city mayor Belen Fernandez" won with 81,977 votes and "incumbent vice mayor Dean Bryan “BK” Kua" with 65,765, figures that match the COMELEC results data, and lists the ten incoming councillors mostly by nickname: Michael Fernandez, Jigs Seen, Atty. Joey Tamayo, Karlos Reyna, Chito Samson, Marvin Fabia, Danee Canto, Tala Paras, Dr. Jaja Cayabyab and Dada Reyna. It is written as a report on the mayor's political slate, so it is used for the fact and date of the election, and counted as name corroboration only where it gives a given name the other sources also use. It states no end year for the term: the 2025–2028 term recorded on the elected-official records follows from the election date and the three-year term of local elective office, not from this article. It is cited on the City Mayor's and City Vice Mayor's office records in addition to the undated directory pages, and is evidence about elected posts only, not about any appointed department head. Its naming a "Karlos Reyna" among the incoming councillors is the reason the /the-city/ roster naming an "Engr. Karlos Reyna IV" as City Tourism Office head is treated as unreliable rather than corroborating.

title: Councilors
licence: Copyright © 2024 – Sangguniang Panlungsod, Dagupan City. All rights reserved. (site footer)
notes: The council's own roster. It lists twelve members, each styled "Hon. …" and captioned "Councilor", under the statement that the council "is composed of 12 councilors, with 10 councilors elected and two councilors elected from the ranks of barangay chairmen and the Sangguniang Kabataan". It does not say which two members hold those seats. Its footer gives the address "2nd Floor SP Building, Dagupan City Hall Complex, A.B. Fernandez Ave., Dagupan City 2400". Undated; the individual profile posts were last modified between 20 and 26 August 2025 according to the CMS, which is not recorded as a publication date. The published member names follow this page's spelling, because it is the council's own list of its members. The profiles carry committee chairmanships for five members only, and they conflict: Councilor Canto's and Councilor Cayabyab's profiles both claim the chair of the Committee on Health and Sanitation; Canto's claims the chair of the Committee on Environmental and Natural Resources, which the city's article of 28 January 2026 gives to Councilor Seen; and Canto's dates her council service "2013 – Present" although the city reported her as a first-time councillor in 2025. No committee assignment is therefore published.

title: 2025 NLE Results — City of Dagupan, Pangasinan (certificate of canvass data)
notes: The read-only data file behind the COMELEC 2025 results website (https://2025electionresults.comelec.gov.ph/) for the City of Dagupan, region code 5518000. The site states its results were last updated "16 May 2025 10:00:09 AM" and reports 100% of certificates of canvass received; `data_as_of` is the election day the figures describe. Mayor: FERNANDEZ, BELEN (PFP) 81,977 votes, LIM, CELIA (NP) 42,200. Vice Mayor: KUA, BRYAN BK (PFP) 65,765, LIM, BRIAN (NP) 57,965. Member, Sangguniang Panlungsod, lone district, the ten highest of 23 candidates: FERNANDEZ, MICHAEL; TAMAYO, ATTY JOEY; PARAS, TALA; SEEN, JIGS; REYNA, KARLOS; CANTO, DANEE; SAMSON, CHITO; FABIA, MARVIN; CAYABYAB, DOC JAJA; REYNA, DADA MANAOIS. Their surnames are those of the ten members the council names as newly sworn in for 2025. Candidates appear under their ballot names, which are often nicknames, so this source counts as name corroboration only where the ballot name carries a given name the other sources also use: Belen Fernandez, Bryan Kua, Michael Fernandez, Karlos Reyna and Marvin Fabia. These are the results transmitted to the results website, not the proclamation of the City Board of Canvassers.

title: Pangasinan QuickStat — October 2024
licence: CC BY 4.0 (rsso01.psa.gov.ph site footer)
notes: Monthly compilation by the PSA Provincial Statistical Office - Pangasinan. Titled "October 2024", but no release date is stated, so `published` is null. Its Demography table lists "Dagupan City" at 174,302 (2020), 171,271 (2015) and 163,676 (2010).
